pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions - Virtual Office Angels
pages.text: Frequently Asked Questions What Is Virtual Assistant? A Virtual Assistant/ Remote worker/ Virtual personal Assistant is an independent entrepreneur providing administrative, website, social media, real estate assistance, marketing and/or technical services. What Type Of Tasks Can Be Executed By Virtual Office Angels’ VA? Our Virtual Assistants are computer savvy and can perform tasks that require no physical presence. A detailed list of the services may be found at www.virtualofficeangels.com.au/services . Should you need a specialised virtual assistant, get in touch so we can further discuss with you options that may assist you. How Would You Know If Your VA Is Working Or Not? All our virtual assistants are required to ALWAYS be online via Microsoft Teams during their shifts monitored by their Team Leaders. A Start of day report is sent once logged in and an End of Day report at the end of every shift. Updates are sent as well on an every 2-hour duration during work shifts. How Are The Accomplished Tasks Delivered? Summary of completed tasks is sent through email with attachments (as the case may be) every end of shift. Clients are likewise updated on tasks as they’re done via Microsoft Teams. Do You Accept Credit Cards? Yes, we accept all major credit cards and PayPal. What Are The Basic Components Cover By My Investment To Outsource Through Your Company? Labor costs – Generally, you pay for the time and services rendered by your VA inclusive of the respective tax deduction for every employee, but costs will vary depending on the worker’s skills and experience. Team Leader – we have Team Leaders who are accountable and manage 5-10 VAs under their individual responsibility. They are also tasked to constantly communicate with the clients, ensuring that needs are met and instructed well to the staff. Consultancy – You shall be provided with heaps of advice by our management team to guarantee the full benefits you can get out of your outsourcing team. F inance – We are responsible of payroll and provides you with one simple bill and monthly timesheet of your VA. Human Resources & Recruitment – we source, screen applicants, appoint, induct and manage your virtual worker for you. We make sure that your offshore team is well supervised by our HR department to bring about the best VA for your specific business requirements through our selection process. What Are The Hours Of Your Business Operations? We follow Australian business hours from 9am-5pm AEST, Mondays to Fridays. However, extra hours may be requested depending on the need beyond normal business hours or during weekends subject to additional hourly fees. Does Your Staff Considering Working On Weekends Or Holidays For Urgent Tasks? Extra hours on weekends/holidays may be accommodated with prior arrangement subject to additional hourly fees. How Is The Communication Skills Of Your Staff? All VAs assigned to each client is highly proficient with the English language including the Team Leaders assigned per V.A. How Do You Keep Your Client’s Privacy? Virtual Office Angels values the confidentiality and privacy of every client that goes on board. As such, all VAs assigned to each client sign a strict Non-Disclosure Agreement. As a matter of protocol, all hard drives are inspected prior to going on board and after each replacement, if necessary. What Are Ways For Us To Get In Touch? All clients may get in touch with their assigned VAs via Microsoft Teams or email. What Is Your Guarantee For Satisfaction? All assigned VAs are managed by highly professional Team Leaders who monitor tasks given. The Team Leader’s completion and regular communication with clients and VAs assigned to, ensure that tasks are done in accordance with each client’s specifications. We trust these are useful in providing essential information related to hiring a virtual worker and provides you a deeper understanding of what to consider once you get started working with your assigned virtual worker. Should there be any other clarifications that you need or questions that you may have, please don’t hesitate to get in touch with us via phone or email us at clientcare@virtualofficeangels.com.au .

pages.title: Virtual Mortgage and Loans Processing Support - Virtual Office Angels
pages.text: Virtual Mortgage and Loans Processing Support Mortgage and loans processing is a painstaking process. It requires accuracy, good analytical skills and focus. And just like any other process, it is tedious and meticulous, takes up a lot of energy, effort and most importantly, time from the Mortgage Broker’s end to ensure its accurate administration, detailed completion and smooth approval yet compliant with all the needed current government legislation requirements – from Application to Settlement. Mortgage and Loans Processing’s Secret Arsenal The extremely repetitive administrative tasks that go along with loans applications and processing can be offloaded from the mortgage broker and delegated to a highly skilled ( and reliable ) virtual loans assistant and administrative support personnel. The mortgage broker then can focus on other more important things that really matter (i.e. those needing utmost business attention – more direct client interaction, speaking and developing client and relations, marketing and growing your business faster and or just doing what you love doing most and spending time with family and loved ones, etc.). Just think about all that time your business spends on all the data-entry, calling up BDMs, the long waiting time for them to answer one call, following-up and chasing needed client documents, ensuring that all documents are complete and up to date, doing serviceability calculations, researching various lenders, ensuring compliances, etc. – and the list goes on…) that comprise the time-consuming and meticulous process of mortgage and loan applications. Now, more than ever, there is a collective urge to do more at once to be able to keep up with your competitors (especially at this time). We, at Virtual Office Angels , can find you a highly skilled Virtual Loans Assistant or a team of Virtual Loans Assistants who are tailored fit according to your specific needs and requirements. Dealing only with highly experienced and skilled virtual loans assistant or a team of virtual loans assistants, we are able to ensure that they can assist you in your mortgage processing needs (from Applications to Settlement) with minimum of fuss, from day one. Equipped with hands-on skills and specific loans software knowledge you require and a good understanding of the Australian Mortgage Financial industry, your highly matched loans virtual assistant will deftly take over the whole loans processing for you From applications up to the settlement (i.e. Data entry to CRM, Loan Structuring Preparation, Cient/Borrower communication and update, Servicing Calculator preparation, valuation ordering and follow up, discharge form preparation, other documents and forms preparation (i.e. FHOG, etc. ) file lodgement, regular Mortgage Broker updates, Regular Borrower updates, etc.) Data Entry to Broker’s CRM Highly experienced (not newly graduate for you to train! ) with whatever loans CRM software knowledge you require (i.e. Connective, Mercury, Podium, Symmetry, Flex, AdviserLogic, COIN, etc. to name a few), our Virtual Assistants are suitably prepared and highly qualified and experienced to take on the meticulous tasks of processing loans and manage the most up-to-date CRM in the market. Documents/Forms Preparation It might seem like the simplest task but documents preparation is the crucial because the required documents that need to be submitted will determine if the loan application will get approved or not. Our highly specialised Virtual Loans Assistants can assist you to handle various back-end support tasks and processing work for your mortgage business. Loan Structuring Preparation Our Virtual Loans Assistants have more than a sharp eye to prepare for the loan structure. With an keen understanding of the Australian Financial loans market and equipped with previous hands-on experience in loan structuring preparation, your assigned Virtual Loans Assistant can assist you in the loans processing and preparation of needed documents to ensure that your client/borrower is able to maximise the loan identified – and gets approved. Client and Loans Broker Updated Communications Throughout the whole process, your Virtual Loans Assistants will be providing you with regular updates and ensuring regular communication are done. The painstaking tasks of liaising between you, your client/borrower and the Financial Institution will be done and completed on a regular basis via an identified process and procedures. You can then be assured that there are no hidden surprises and open communication amongst all stakeholders is maintained. Lender Research Depending on your requirement and or process and procedures, part of the virtual assistant’s loans processing procedure is doing the time-consuming lender research. This is to ensure that thorough due diligence is done and appropriate research is made to ensure that only the best are identified for your client/borrower (i.e. for the best lender, rates, best current deals, etc. ) in the market are exhausted and compared. If properly done then this is one big beneficial for you and your company, saving your time and offloading this tasks to a reliable virtual loans assistant. Settlement and Updates Up until the settlement of the loan, our virtual loans assistants are with you every step of the way ensuring you are kept updated on the status of your loan as well as with whatever comes up in the process will be addressed. Start Reaping The Benefits Now With all of those painstaking and crucial tasks out of the way, your business can now focus more on optimizing other resources, building a more lasting relationship with your current (and new) client base, as well as and strengthening your business to take it to the next level. To find out more how you can start to reap the benefits of having your own highly skilled Virtual Assistant who is tailored fit for your specific business needs, call us now on 1300 737 883 .
